title: Marlowe & Finch Unlimited Benefit: Higher Consolidation Move Limit
content:
A holder's Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership raises the move limit of a Gift Cards & Store Credit consolidation of value carried onto a card by replacement. The amount is added to the move limit after the move limit's application for the age of the stolen or lost card.

| Marlowe & Finch Unlimited membership on the consolidation date | Added to the move limit (USD) |
|---|---|
| Status trial or active, and the plan covers return labels | 40.00 |
| Status trial or active, and the plan does not cover return labels | 20.00 |
| No membership in status trial or active | Nothing |

Status and whether the plan covers return labels are read from the holder's Unlimited holding; a membership in any other status (for example past due, cancellation pending or expired) adds nothing.

## Illustrations (hypothetical move limit of 90.00 after its application for card age)

| Unlimited position | Move limit |
|---|---|
| Active, plan covers return labels | 130.00 |
| Trial, plan does not cover return labels | 110.00 |
| Past due | 90.00 |
